title: Direct Salts Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid is crafted for vapers who appreciate absolute purity and crispness. This straightforward recipe focuses entirely on the traditional, slightly botanical properties of classic Menthol. It delivers an immediate frosty punch, leaving the palate feeling thoroughly cleansed and revitalised. This blend provides a consistently brisk, deeply cooling sensation from the inhale right through to the exhale. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the pure chill of Menthol, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the exotic Fruity Juice, the sharp Blueberry Sour Raspberry, or the sweet Gummy Bear.
